title: Krabserv Pack V
description: A modpack for the Krabserv V players !
body:
# Krabserv Pack V

This modpack is for use by players of the Krabserv V.

No mods are contained in this modpack, only dependencies.

It contains mostly optimisation mods, some QoL mods, the VoiceChat mod, and Distant Horizons (for far better render distance).

You can use this for an enhanced/optimized vanilla experience, but do not expect support !
